model.boundary: resident old convergence, batch maintenance and device preparation through new convergence; no host time
model.correction: Spine residual correction is oracle-directed timed work replay, not a functional AXI-derived seed implementation
model.energy: all-32-channel DRAMSim3 total incl. background/refresh; modeled HBM, not measured FPGA energy
model.g: finite natural-geometry/shared-metadata G; original-G performance not admitted
model.memory: Direct DRAMSim3, all 32 channels, 512 MiB/channel, 32 outstanding/channel
model.pma_reservation: exact future batch and zero-source reservation convention retained from SSSP study
model.r: prefetch_gather_reuse, algorithm-specific finite apply and timed PR preparation
model.rank_oracle: independent double Jacobi; L1 error <= V*epsilon/(1-damping)
model.residual_contract: hardware-warm dangling L-infinity, fixed per-vertex epsilon, damping=FP32(0.85)
model.resource_control: latest R resource budget, not a strict same-resource original-A4 reproduction

not_claimed: not FPGA timing/energy, not a hardware-equivalent complete G+R image
not_packaged: graph/state arrays and tool binaries are path/hash-indexed, not embedded
